# `modules/EditorCollab.js`

> **Source:** `editor/js/modules/EditorCollab.js`

EditorCollab.js Editor-side integration for the collab system. Mounts onto EditorApp and wires all hooks. Hooks wired: - EditorHistory.pushAction  → broadcast op to peers - ProjectStorage.saveProject → broadcast snapshot - PrefabLibrary.save/delete  → broadcast prefab ops - Viewport render loop       → presence tick at 10 Hz - EditorApp.enterPlayMode    → broadcast play_sync - EditorApp.togglePause      → broadcast pause_sync - EditorApp.exitPlayMode     → broadcast stop_sync

## Functions

### `initEditorCollab(editor)`

Initialize the collab system and attach it to the editor. Called from EditorApp.initialize() at the end.

### `destroyEditorCollab(editor)`

Destroy the collab system and remove all hooks.

### `getCollabState(editor)`

Get the current collab state from the editor.

### `isCollabActive(editor)`

### `isCollabConnected(editor)`

### `getCollabPeers(editor)`

### `getCollabPresenceList(editor)`

### `getCollabInterpCamera(editor, peerId)`

Get Hermite-interpolated camera for a remote peer (smooth, per-frame). Returns { pos: [x,y,z], target: [x,y,z] } or null.

### `getCollabStats(editor)`

Get collab camera interpolation + connection stats for UI display.

### `getCollabRouterStats(editor)`

Get message router stats for bandwidth monitoring. Returns { sent, dropped, coalesced, bytesSent, backpressureFrames, rateMultiplier }

### `getCollabInterpDelay(editor)`

Get the current adaptive interpolation delay (ms). On LAN: ~20ms. On jittery connections: up to 150ms. Auto-adjusts each frame.

### `collabPresenceTick(editor)`

Called from Viewport render loop to send presence at 10 Hz.

### `exportCollabTimeline(editor)`

Export local timeline as JSON download.

### `collabTrackGrab(editor, entityId)`

Notify collab that local user started grabbing an entity (play mode). Claims per-entity ownership at GRABBED priority so our transforms are authoritative.

### `collabUntrackGrab(editor, entityId)`

Notify collab that local user released a grabbed entity. Releases per-entity ownership so default authority resumes.

### `collabClaimSelected(editor, entityId)`

Claim ownership of an entity at SELECTED priority (inspector editing).

### `collabReleaseEntity(editor, entityId)`

Release ownership of an entity (selected or grabbed).

### `getCollabEntityOwner(editor, entityId)`

Get the current owner of an entity. Returns { ownerId, priority } or null.

### `isCollabEntityLocallyOwned(editor, entityId)`

Check if the local peer owns an entity.

### `getCollabGrabGlows(editor)`

Get map of entityId → color hex for entities being grabbed by remote peers. Used by Viewport to render grab glow.

### `isCollabPlayAuthority(editor)`

Returns true if this peer is the physics authority during play mode. Non-authority peers should skip local physics stepping and instead receive transforms from the authority.

### `collabInterpolateFrame(editor)`

Interpolate buffered remote transforms. Call every render frame on non-authority peers. Smoothly tweens entity positions between received keyframes with a 100ms render delay.

### `hostRoom(editor, roomId, wordKey, numberKey)`

Host a room. Auto-generates word key and number key if not provided. Starts signaling so peers can discover this host.

### `setCollabRoom(editor, roomId, wordKey, numberKey, hostId, hostFingerprint)`

Join a room with dual-key authentication (all 3 must match the host). Legacy alias: setCollabRoomId calls this.

### `setCollabRoomId(editor, roomId)`

### `setAnonMode(editor, enabled)`

Toggle anonymous mode. Must be called BEFORE hostRoom/joinRoom. When enabled: - Peers get random anonymous IDs (different each session) - Real peer IDs are stripped from all ops - TURN-only relay hides IP addresses - Garlic encryption prevents relay from reading message content

**Parameters:**

- `editor` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `enabled` *(boolean)* — _No description in source JSDoc._

### `leaveRoom(editor)`

Leave the current room. Stops signaling and clears peer state. Does NOT destroy the collab system — user can Host/Join again.

### `generateWordKey()`

Generate a random word key (two words joined by a dash). 120 words × 120 words = 14,400 combinations per word pair.

### `generateNumberKey()`

Generate a random 6-digit number key. 900,000 combinations (100000-999999). Total key space with words: 120×120×900000 ≈ 12.96 billion combinations.

### `encodeInviteCode(roomId, wordKey, numberKey, hostId, hostFingerprint)`

Encode room credentials into a single invite code string. Format: PE-<base64url(roomId § wordKey § numberKey § hostId § hostFingerprint)> The hostFingerprint (16 hex chars) allows joiners to verify host identity.

**Returns:** invite code

### `decodeInviteCode(code)`

Decode an invite code back to { roomId, wordKey, numberKey, hostId, hostFingerprint }. Returns null if the code is invalid.

### `setAutoMod(editor, enabled)`

Toggle auto-moderation (auto-kick, mute, throttle from integrity violations). Only the host can enable/disable. Off by default.

**Returns:** new state

### `kickPeer(editor, peerId)`

Kick a peer from the room. Only the host (first connected) should call this. Broadcasts a __kick__ op, then the kicked peer clears its stored credentials.

### `getSavedRoomCredentials()`

Get saved room credentials from localStorage.

**Returns:** | null}

### `clearRoomCredentials()`

Clear saved room credentials (called on kick or manual disconnect).

### `injectCollabStorageDeps(deps)`

### `injectCollabHistoryHelpers(helpers)`

### `editorCollabCompositeSuffix(raw)`

Build a composite project ID from room + wordKey + numberKey. The composite is used as the BitTorrent info_hash seed, so only peers with all 3 matching values will discover each other on the swarm. IMPORTANT: NEVER returns a bare roomId. Even without keys, a random salt is included so two users with the same folder name can't collide. The hostId (selfId of host) is mixed in when hosting to guarantee that different hosts with identical room+word+number still get unique swarms. Uses FNV-1a 64-bit (emulated as two 32-bit hashes) for collision resistance.

## Notes & Examples

### Editor Extension System

The editor supports extensions via the same Plauna component system as apps. Extensions can add panels, tools, menu items, and hooks into the engine. They run with elevated 'editor' capability granting access to the scene graph, asset database, and build pipeline.

**Example: Editor extension adding a custom panel**
```js
import { Extension } from 'editor/core/Extension.js';
import { Panel } from 'editor/ui/Panel.js';

class TerrainEditor extends Extension {
  id = 'terrain-editor';
  capabilities = ['editor', 'scene'];
  
  activate(context) {
    // Add menu item
    context.menus.add('Tools/Terrain', () => this.open());
    
    // Register tool
    context.tools.register('terrain', {
      icon: 'mountain',
      onSelect: (entity) => this.edit(entity)
    });
  }
  
  open() {
    this.panel = new Panel({
      title: 'Terrain Editor',
      content: this.buildUI()
    });
    context.workspace.addPanel(this.panel);
  }
  
  edit(entity) {
    const terrain = entity.get(TerrainComponent);
    this.panel.bind(terrain);
  }
}

editor.extensions.register(TerrainEditor);
```

**See also:** [Editor Overview](/editor/overview.md)
